# MediBang Paint

> > Free digital art and manga creation software available across Windows, Mac, iPad, iPhone, and Android platforms with cloud storage and premium features.

MediBang Paint is a comprehensive digital illustration suite designed for manga creators, artists, and illustrators. The platform offers native applications across desktop and mobile platforms, featuring intuitive drawing tools, customizable brushes, cloud-based collaboration, and premium subscription options for advanced features.
